hook: 3 AI tricks to *clear your inbox* faster

items.title: Get the point of a *long thread*
items.prompt: Summarize this email thread in 3 bullets. What do I need to do?
answer: ==→ You: send a draft by Wednesday==

items.title: Say no to a meeting, *nicely*
items.prompt: Help me politely decline this meeting and ask for an email update instead.
answer: "Thanks for the invite! I can't make it,
==but could you send a quick update by email?==

items.title: Reply in *2 lines*, not 20
items.prompt: Write a 2-line reply: I'll send the report Friday. Friendly, not formal.
answer: ==I'll have the report over to you by Friday."==

caption:
3 AI tricks to clear your inbox faster 📥

Save this for Monday morning. Paste the email into any AI chat, then use one of these:

1️⃣ Long thread?
"Summarize this email thread in 3 bullets. What do I need to do?"

2️⃣ Meeting you don't need?
"Help me politely decline this meeting and ask for an email update instead."

3️⃣ Quick reply?
"Write a 2-line reply: [what you want to say]. Friendly, not formal."
